name: TrustBench
description: Non-custodial routing and policy layer for x402 paid agent calls. Wraps x402-conforming providers with idempotency keys, hard spend caps, Ed25519-signed audit receipts, and a queryable receipt endpoint. Agents sign their own EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization with their own wallet (Coinbase Agentic Wallet recommended); TrustBench constructs the quote, routes to a probed and scored provider, observes the on-chain settlement, and emits a receipt that any third party can verify offline against the published public key.

returns.payment_requirements_v2: raw merchant accepts[0] when present (null for v0.x merchants)

routeSettle.body: Either {route_id, signature} (legacy v0.x) or {route_id, x_payment} (SDK-built X-PAYMENT base64). Mutually exclusive.
routeSettle.returns: {response, receipt} plus X-Receipt-Id header. Idempotent on (route_id, payment); replays return x-idempotent-replay: true.

failureModes.502: provider_settlement_missing (no tx_hash recoverable from merchant; no receipt issued)

receipt.auth: none (public, ULID acts as audit token)

capabilitiesNote: Aligned with Coinbase Agentic Market's 5-category taxonomy as of Phase 4 (2026-05-05). The crawler stores other categories it observes (e.g. Travel, Social, Storage, Trading) in the providers table but does not route them until they graduate into the canonical 5 above.

signing.fallbackAlgorithm: HMAC-SHA256 (server-internal only; publicKeyUrl returns 503 in fallback mode)

custody.claim: TrustBench never holds funds, never signs payments, and never broadcasts transactions. The agent signs an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization with its own wallet; the merchant submits the on-chain transaction with its own gas wallet; TrustBench observes the resulting tx_hash and emits a signed receipt.

pricing.phase4Status: invite-only during the build; access via direct message to @TrustBench on X

policyPrimitives.idempotencyKeys: 16-128 char header on every POST /route. Same key + same body = cached replay. Same key + different body = 409.
policyPrimitives.hardSpendCaps: Per-call cap and rolling-window daily cap, both enforced server-side, both denominated in atomic USDC.
policyPrimitives.signedReceipts: Ed25519 over JCS-canonical receipt body. Detached signature so public_key_url can be overridden at verification time.
policyPrimitives.queryableAudit: GET /receipts/:id returns the exact signed envelope. ULID-keyed, immutable, public, cache-friendly.

phases.phase3Surfaces: Authenticated POST /route + POST /route/settle, GET /receipts/:id, scripts/verify-receipt.js, paid-probe.ts. Smoke A1-A5 / B1-B4 green against the local mock provider.
phases.phase4InProgress: Discovery surfaces (skill.md, manifest, llms.txt route), registry refresh against x402.org/ecosystem, taxonomy alignment to 5-cat (Search / Inference / Data / Media / Infra), Agentic Market crawler integration. First paid receipt against a real x402 provider in flight pending facilitator clarification.
phases.phase5Planned: p402, KYB and identity attestations, settlement-finality semantics across protocols, Canton coverage.
